name: AI Detection
summary: Text checker that rates AI versus human authorship and flags plagiarism, with PDF reports and an API.
description: NanoGPT's AI writing and plagiarism checker: paste or upload English text (TXT, Markdown, CSV, PDF, DOCX, extracted locally) and get an AI-written versus human likelihood with segment-level highlights, source matches and similarity scores. Metered at $0.00625 per 1,000 characters; every completed check includes a free PDF report, and the same check is available through a REST API endpoint with a NanoGPT API key.
